title: Battle Monsters
native_title: バトル・モンスターズ
overview:
Only the chosen gather,
and the battle reaches its climax.

Screams, wailing, and then, delight! Only the truly strong will win this battle.

Every thousand years, the Monarch of Hell holds a tournament among monsters and demons to decide who will rule the netherworld for the next millennium. Choose one of twelve digitized fiends and fight on multi-level stages where you can leap between platforms, attack foes above or below you, and use objects in the arena against them. The camera zooms in and out as the fighters close in or spread apart.

Time your taunts to build up your mana gauge, then unleash a super special move when it is full. Beat every rival, then face the four bosses known as the Big 4.

- One-player tournament, or two-player battles
- Life shown as a row of candles, with an hourglass round timer
- Five difficulty levels; timer and rounds can be set
- Supports the Multi Terminal 6 and Virtua Stick

選ばれし者たちのみが集い
そして闘いは佳境を迎える。

叫び、慟哭、そして、喜悦！
真の強者のみが、この闘いを制する。
